subject: Schema-driven enablement playbook: streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Raman <priya@novahealth.com>, Greg Owens <gowens@novahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Schema-driven enablement playbook: streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs

Hi Priya / Greg —

Great to kick this off. Per our discovery call, Nova Health wants structured output and streaming responses for real-time triage, plus the ability for the model to call internal tools (lab-lookup, patient-synonymizer) with deterministic JSON payloads. To keep the rollout low-risk we propose a schema-driven enablement playbook with an initial technical walkthrough and two-week implementation sprint.

Proposed agenda for the kickoff call (30–45m):
- Quick goals alignment (5m)
- Streaming behavior expectations and SLOs (10m)
- Function / tool-calling contract: input, output schemas and failure modes (10m)
- Validation & test harness: JSON schema validation, sample payloads (5m)
- Next steps and owners (5m)

Deliverables from Redwood for the sprint:
- Reference JSON schemas for each tool call and structured output (attached: schema-examples.json)
- Enablement playbook PDF with rollout checklist and fallback policies (attached)
- Sandbox endpoints and a small test harness for continuous validation

Open questions for Nova Health before kickoff:
- Example payloads for lab lookup and triage events (to map field types)
- Security constraints (are you okay with a Redwood-managed sandbox in us-west?)
- Primary technical contact for SSO/API keys

Can you confirm availability for a technical walkthrough next week? I can do Wed 7/21 10–11am PT or Thu 7/22 2–3pm PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer 
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments referenced: enablement-playbook-v1.pdf, schema-examples.json

From: Priya Raman <priya@novahealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greg Owens <gowens@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Schema-driven enablement playbook: streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs

Thanks Markus — this looks great. Wed 7/21 10–11am PT works for us (I'll send a calendar invite). A couple quick notes before the call:

- We can supply sample payloads by EOD Monday (personally will coordinate with our integration team).
- Compliance: sandbox in us-west is fine but we need an ATO checklist — can you surface any SOC2 evidence and data retention defaults during the walkthrough?
- For tool-calls, we need strong validation and a clear error contract; if the model invokes a tool with bad args we must not expose PII.

One ask from Greg: can you include an example of a streaming partial response + eventual JSON object (i.e., incremental tokens streamed, then final structured payload)? That helps our UX team.

Appreciate it — Priya
Priya Raman
Director, Product Integrations
Nova Health Systems
priya@novahealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Schema-driven enablement playbook: streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs

Looping in Sergio for engineering bandwidth. Notes from my side:

- We should assign an engineer (Sergio) to build the validator + sandbox connector. Estimate: 10 days for validator + schema test harness, 4 days for sandbox tool adapters.
- Recommend we provide two schema flavors: "lenient" (for early integration) and "strict" (for production go-live). Provide a migration checklist.
- For streaming, include a feature flag so Nova can opt-out per-route during initial rollout.
- I'll take ownership of the enablement playbook PDF and SOW patch; Markus can finalize the technical checklist and samples.

Sergio — could you confirm you can start Monday 7/26 if we lock scope by 7/22? Also attaching a quick schema draft (schema-examples.json) for review.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: schema-examples.json

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Raman <priya@novahealth.com>, Greg Owens <gowens@novahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Schema-driven enablement playbook: streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs

Thanks all — confirmed for Wed 7/21 10–11am PT (invite sent). Finalizing a short playbook and sample payloads for the call. Quick summary of agreed next steps and owners:

1) Redwood: finalize reference JSON schemas (lenient + strict) and upload to the Drive folder by 7/21 EOD — Owner: Markus (attachment: schema-examples.json)
2) Redwood Engineering: provide sandbox connector and validator; target branch & test harness by 8/6 — Owner: Sergio
3) Nova Health: deliver example payloads and any PII redaction rules by 7/21 AM — Owner: Priya
4) CS / SRE: agree SLOs for streaming (p95 < 250ms per token, retention 30d) and fallback policy — Owner: Monica
5) Commercial: SOW update and sign-off; draft SOW attached for internal review (sow-nhs.docx)

During the walkthrough we'll demo: streaming partials + final JSON, a failed tool-call scenario and the validation error payload, and a canary rollout plan (per-route feature flag).

If anything above looks off please flag before the call. Otherwise see you Wednesday.

Best,
Markus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: enablement-playbook-v1.pdf, schema-examples.json, sow-nhs.docx
